name: Zero-size or zero-opacity text
description: Instructions hidden with a zero font size or a zero opacity, which makes text invisible to humans but readable by agents. GLS-HI-002 lists font-size:0 and opacity:0 as words, but the text is folded before words are looked up and the fold turns every 0 into an o, so those two words could never be found there. This rule reads them as a complete zero value instead (the number, an optional unit, optional spaces and comments, then the end of the declaration), and only when the zero sits in a tag's own style and the text of that same element, up to the next tag, carries an instruction aimed at the reader or the agent. A stylesheet rule is never read, so ordinary zero states (a fade class, a reset, an animation) stay clean.
